records.author: Liz
records.body: I have two Hemnes bookcases but needed something smaller for art supplies and books and when I saw the blue I fell in love! Bought a few extra glass shelves and baskets to organize my once unruly paints and pencils, power cords and electronics—my work laptop, personal laptop, Kindle and iPad are all easy to find—and it’s perfect. I smile whenever I look at my space. Thinking of buying a third just for manga and merch.
records.title: Color won me over

records.author: Marie
records.body: Both back panels on this bookshelves are damaged.  I need a call
records.title: Damage

records.author: Kevin
records.body:
Bought the larger bookshelf about a year ago and recently decided to expand my fiancées library. Got home only to notice my current bookshelf was 2-3 shades darker. Thought I purchased the wrong finish, so I disassembled everything, returned it, bought the darker finish. I got home only to realize this also didn’t match. When I talked to customer service I was told occasionally their suppliers change and there was nothing I could do about it. 

So long story short: Don’t purchase these if you plan on expanding your library later on, or if you are buying them to expand the bookshelf you already own.
records.title: Great bookshelf, but don’t plan on expanding it later

records.author: Cynthia
records.body: We had two awkward little alcoves that were wasted space. These bookcases fit beautifully.
records.title: Good choice

records.author: Betty
records.body: Was looking for additional storage for my closet.  The versatile of this storage unit was just the right solution.  It fit nicely into the corner of my closet turning dead space into additional storage.  I would highly recommend it.
records.title: Just the right size

records.author: W Thomas
records.body: Today's Billy Bookcases are not the same as the ones I bought 15+ years ago.  Color, wood pattern, and size have changed.  Nothing matches.  Why call them by the same name if they have changed?  I hope the new ones are as sturdy as the older ones.
records.title: If you change the game, change the name.

records.author: Sara
records.body: I purchased one bookcase and then quickly bought 3 more.  The verticality really helps with storage in small spaces and they hold quite a bit.  Recommend.
records.title: So good, I purchased 4

records.author: Bobby
records.body: Assembly was not difficult. Love the black oak effect.
records.title: Good Looking Bookcase

records.author: Pamela
records.body: My husband and I recently moved into a new home and bought 2 Billy Bookcases to augment the closet system in our primary bedroom. We have never had to assemble furniture before and found the bookcases easy to put together, attractive, sturdy and functional! We are now considering the Billy Bookcase cabinet system for our back entry drop zone. Great product, Ikea!
records.title: Operation Billy Bookcase

records.author: Monica
records.body: We use these everywhere, Large spaces, small spaces, they just work. They look great and I LOVE that you can add a bit of wallpaper or paint to the backing and give it all kinds of character.
records.title: What a versatile shelf!

records.author: Diane
records.body: I purchased this recently to organize my husband‘s video games. I only had a limited amount of space to put an organizer and this was perfect. My husband also loved it because now all his games were nice, organized and easier to find what he is looking for.
records.title: Perfect for small spaces

records.author: Sara
records.body: Please restock, I need another! Its so perfect.
records.title: THE BEST COLOR

records.author: Daniel
records.body: I really like the look of this bookcase, but IKEA offers no way to purchase additional blue shelves for this piece. If you want more blue shelves than what is provided, you will have to buy entire additional bookcase.
records.title: No additional shelving

records.author: Eduardo
records.body: Easy to assembly.Perfect fit for my place.
records.title: Billy Bookcase

records.author: Richard
records.body: Good construction, great price. Instruction pictorial needs some study before diving. Be sure you don't need the larger model.
records.title: Great small bookcase.

records.author: John
records.body: I needed storage space in my bathroom and the bookcase fit the spot and now my bathroom is organized and everything is easy to locate. My home has a lot of storage issues and this is one of my solutions.
records.title: billy to the rescue

records.author: Margarita
records.body:
I got 5 units to build a custom media center for my office/playroom for my son and I to have better organization. Each unit took me less that 15 minutes to build! We added the doors as well for a cleaner look (I get overstimulated easily with messes). I used the Billy tool to help create what I was looking for! 
I will say, delivery took forever so in the future I would much rather use the click and collect option and pick it up myself or just go in and shop what I need. Thank you ikea for creating such creative and amazing storage hacks!
records.title: Billy is the way to go!!

records.author: Tina
records.body: Bought the corner hardware separately. They went together easily (make sure you have a ratcheting screwdriver to avoid hand pain and cracking the particleboard veneer).
records.title: Great Shelves

records.author: Dana
records.body: I bought 3 with the corner connector kit. Top half is super easy, bottom half not so and once they're in place good luck if you need to shift them BUT! I adore the bookcases. Perfect depth for little book display setups, fits quite a lot if you're just shelving books. Addons are good too, I plan to build a whole library wall with these complete with ladder rail eventually.
records.title: Perfect for books/media display!

records.author: Jennifer
records.body: Affordable, easy assembly, and the height extensions are amazing!!!
records.title: Love this Bookcase
